title: chrysodium aureonitens
intro: Chrysodium aureonitens, commonly known as the Golden Pothos, is a flowering plant species in the family Arum. The Golden Pothos is known for its air-purifying properties and health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety, promoting better sleep, and boosting the immune system. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an adaptogen, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, while its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds. Additionally, the Golden Pothos is also known to have antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress.
